title: Edge of the stage
what: A close, large view of the stage edge: a pleated drape, side legs, a hanging truss with speaker arrays and lamps, a big followspot, lectern, stool, mic stand and monitors, the stage fascia, a pit rail and the backs of the first three rows with heads, collars and lanyards.
why: It puts you at the lip of the stage with the people behind you: the lamp is close enough to see its fins, and the heads in front say that someone is always watching. The big pool on the boards is the contributor's moment at its most direct.
how: One 612 by 720 SVG at a larger scale than the others; the foreground rows are three sizes of the same seat back and head so they read as depth. The pointer moves the wide pool over the floor and the big lamp swings to follow; floor lines and the mic stand turn blue inside it. Draw-in on entry, static under reduced motion, scales down on mobile.
